description: One floor or area of the building as the Warehouse Map page draws it: a floor plan picture kept as a private file, and the boxes placed over it, each tied to a Warehouse. Edited on the Warehouse Map page by people with the Warehouse Map Editor role. It never creates, renames or moves a Warehouse and never touches stock.

fields.description: Lower numbers come first in the list of floors.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: A disabled map is left off the Warehouse Map page for everyone but its editors. This list still shows it to anyone who can read maps.
fields.label: Disabled

fields.description: The floor plan picture drawn behind the boxes. Uploaded on the Warehouse Map page (Edit map), always as a private file: a public file or a web address is refused.
fields.label: Floor Plan Picture

fields.description: The drawing's width in map units. With a picture, the picture's width in pixels.
fields.label: Width

name: Warehouse Floor Map
